第93章 看电影-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

这次，吴姜没有拒绝，凭两人现在的关系，千儿八百的，实在没有计较的必要。

只是一想到这事，吴姜心里就来气，就算他的车子不用多少油，充电也花不了多少钱，但刘航连意思一下都没有，他就不爽。

而且，为了他家的事，赵安坤可是从南到北跑了大半个华国，结果，就只给了两万块钱，打发叫花子呢。

不过，赵安坤都没说什么，吴姜也不好开口。

吴姜先开车将赵安坤送回了家，两人约好以后有时间再聚，随后，吴姜便开车返回了自己的住处。

已经和阮柏云约好了，晚上在他家聚聚，下午没事，正好在家里休息一下。

虽然从外表上看，吴姜和平时没什么两样，但只有他自己知道，昨晚受的伤，没那么容易好利索。

回到自己住处，吴姜简单洗漱了一番，便倒头睡了过去。

等他醒来时，已经下午四点半了，看了看手机，上面还有一条李月芽的消息。

吴姜洗了把脸，拿起车钥匙，朝着隔壁房间喊了一声：“念念，走了，咱们去看你爸爸妈妈！”

“来啦！”小丫头兴奋的从隔壁跑了出来，显然，能去见爸爸妈妈，让她非常的高兴。

下楼的时候，给李月芽打了个电话，让她在小区门口等着自己。

等吴姜到的时候，已经远远的就看见李月芽站在那里了。

还是一头利落的短发，衬得脸庞愈发娇俏，完美贴合她活泼爽朗的气质，手里还攥着一幅卷起来的书画。

一上车，李月芽就瞪着吴姜，气愤的说道：“死猪头，为什么不回我信息？”

吴姜随口回了句，“睡觉呢，没听见，你手里拿的是什么？”

李月芽哼了一声，才说道：“礼物啊，这是我爸求咱们绿城书法协会会长写的一幅字。小姜子，你不会大过年的，空手去别人家做客吧？”

吴姜挑了挑眉，一脸得意地笑了：“我还用带别的礼物？我亲手画的符，驱邪避灾，不比什么协会会长的书法要香吗？再说了，对阮哥和秦姐来说，我带着念念过去，就是最好的礼物。”

This time, Wu Jiang did not refuse. With the current relationship between the two of them, there was no need to argue.

Just thinking about this made Wu Jiang angry. Even if his car didn't use much gas and charging didn't cost much, Liu Hang didn't even think about it, and he was upset.

Moreover, for his family's affairs, Zhao Ankun traveled half of China from south to north, but in the end, he only gave him 20,000 yuan and sent him off as a beggar.

However, Zhao Ankun didn't say anything, and Wu Jiang couldn't speak either.

Wu Jiang first drove Zhao Ankun back home, and the two made an appointment to meet again when they had time. Afterwards, Wu Jiang drove back to his residence.

I have made an appointment with Ruan Boyun to get together at his house in the evening. I have nothing to do in the afternoon, so I just want to take a rest at home.

Although Wu Jiang looked the same on the outside as usual, only he knew that the injury he suffered last night would not be easy to recover from.

After returning to his residence, Wu Jiang simply washed up and fell asleep.

When he woke up, it was already four-thirty in the afternoon. He looked at his phone and there was a message from Li Yueya on it.

Wu Jiang washed his face, picked up the car keys, and shouted into the next room: "Nian Nian, let's go, let's go see your parents!"

"Here we come!" The little girl ran out from next door excitedly. Obviously, she was very happy to be able to see her parents.

When he went downstairs, he called Li Yueya and asked her to wait for him at the gate of the community.

When Wu Jiang arrived, he saw Li Yueya standing there from a distance.

She still has neat short hair, which makes her face more delicate and charming, perfectly fitting her lively and cheerful temperament. She also holds a rolled-up calligraphy and painting in her hand.

As soon as she got in the car, Li Yueya stared at Wu Jiang and said angrily: "You damn pig head, why didn't you reply to my message?"

Wu Jiang replied casually, "I was sleeping, so I didn't hear you. What is that in your hand?"

Li Yueya snorted and then said: "It's a gift. This is a calligraphy that my father asked the president of our Greentown Calligraphy Association to write. Xiao Jiangzi, you won't be celebrating the New Year and go to other people's homes empty-handed, right?"

Wu Jiang raised his eyebrows and smiled smugly: "What other gifts should I bring? Isn't the talisman I drew myself to ward off evil spirits and avoid disasters more fragrant than the calligraphy of the president of some association? Besides, for Brother Ruan and Sister Qin, it is the best gift for me to bring them with you."
